title: Detector-Conditioned Source-Space Nulls and Null-Mask Loss in a Programmable Two-Slit Interferometer
summary: Afshar's double-slit experiment probes wave--particle complementarity by placing a wire grid at the dark fringes of a downstream interference pattern while retaining an imaging basis that appears to preserve which-path information. Here we propose and analyze a time-reversed Young--Afshar configuration in which the corresponding null test is transferred from the downstream field plane to the source-label plane of a time-reversed Young interferometer.
